test_title: RRB ALP CBT-I 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 27 Nov, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: A shopkeeper bought an article for ₹319.60. Approximately, at what price should he sell the article to make a 25% profit?
solution:
**Given:**

Cost price of the article = ₹319.60

Profit percentage = 25%

**Formula Used:**

Selling Price (SP) = Cost Price (CP) + Profit

Profit = (Profit percentage × Cost Price) / 100

**Calculation:**

Profit = (25 × 319.60) / 100

⇒ Profit = 79.90

Selling Price (SP) = 319.60 + 79.90

⇒ Selling Price (SP) = 399.50

The shopkeeper should sell the article for ₹400 (approximately) to make a 25% profit.
